name: Hippocampus
description: Fast neuron routing: recognises learned requests and decides without generating tokens, leaving only what needs reasoning to the cortex.
capabilities: Three-outcome arbiter: fast, grey zone, slow, with a reason
Encrypted and signed neuron memory, no user text in telemetry
Rust core with explicit degradation when a component is missing
Learns repeated requests by itself: the model writes the skill, Nuxiva tests and isolates it before adopting it
Automatic QLoRA training when a graphics card is detected and the user allows it
Nightly consolidation: forgets what is not needed and catches up on missed nights
